name: commercengine/skills
description: Official Commerce Engine e-commerce skills for AI coding agents

metadata.description: Complete Commerce Engine toolkit with router for SDK setup, authentication, catalog, cart/checkout, orders, analytics, webhooks, SSR/meta-framework patterns (Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, SvelteKit), SEO, and AI agent tools

plugins.name: ce
plugins.description: Commerce Engine router - automatically routes to the right skill based on your e-commerce task

plugins.name: ce-setup
plugins.description: Set up the Commerce Engine TypeScript SDK in any project with framework detection and token storage selection

plugins.name: ce-auth
plugins.description: Commerce Engine authentication - anonymous auth, OTP login (email/phone/WhatsApp), password auth, token refresh, account recovery, user profile and customer attribute management

plugins.name: ce-catalog
plugins.description: Commerce Engine product catalog - products, variants, SKUs, categories, faceted search, reviews, and recommendations

plugins.name: ce-cart-checkout
plugins.description: Commerce Engine cart management, checkout flow, and payment integration with hosted checkout support

plugins.name: ce-orders
plugins.description: Commerce Engine order management - create orders, shipment tracking, payment status, cancellation, returns, and refunds

plugins.name: ce-analytics
plugins.description: Segment / RudderStack e-commerce analytics for Commerce Engine storefronts using @commercengine/analytics. Maps products, carts, orders and users to Segment spec events, deduplicates browser events against Commerce Engine's server-side copies with the events storefront SDK mutations return, identifies users after login, and collects ad-platform click identifiers.

plugins.name: ce-webhooks
plugins.description: Commerce Engine webhooks - 241 signed events across orders, payments, shipping, carts, catalog, customers, store and marketplace, with X-CE-Signature verification, event_id idempotency and retry handling

plugins.name: ce-ssr-patterns
plugins.description: SSR/meta-framework patterns for Commerce Engine storefronts using @commercengine/storefront. Covers Next.js, TanStack Start, Astro, and SvelteKit with publicStorefront(), clientStorefront(), serverStorefront(), bootstrap, server functions/actions, pre-rendering, and cookie-based token management.

plugins.name: ce-ssr
plugins.description: Build custom SSR bindings with @commercengine/ssr-utils for frameworks without a first-party Commerce Engine wrapper (Nuxt and other unsupported frameworks). CookieAdapter, ServerTokenStorage, and public vs session patterns.

plugins.name: ce-seo
plugins.description: SEO and agent-readable content for Commerce Engine storefronts using @commercengine/seo. Route records for CMS-owned URLs, head metadata, JSON-LD (Product/ProductGroup with variesBy), canonical URLs, robots.txt, sitemaps, llms.txt, and Markdown mirrors across React SPA, Next.js, Astro, SvelteKit, and TanStack Start.

plugins.name: ce-ai
plugins.description: WebMCP agent tools for Commerce Engine storefronts using @commercengine/ai. Exposes catalog search, product/variant lookup, real cart mutations, navigation, and session state to browser AI agents via document.modelContext.
